_purpose: An index of verified archived conversation sessions, not a substitute for actual message content.
_limits: Only verified actual session keys with verified file paths; no fictional message backfill. Public repository; avoid private details.

_session_fields.session_key: Permanent key per actual conversation, not invented ChatGPT ID
_session_fields.latest_archive_path: Verified actual day archive file path
_session_fields.last_activity_local: Timestamp observed from reliable source or null

_index_policy: Append/update a session only after its verbatim day archive exists and has been read back. Concurrent writes use latest SHA and merge; no fake sessions. Automation may read this index to find verified recent user replies from a different ChatGPT conversation but must not infer read/unread status.
